subject: Systemic Racism Public Health Emergency
overview: The City Council voted to declare systemic racism a public health emergency and called for public community forums on anti-racism and policing. The Council also referred a proposed adult-use marijuana zoning ordinance to the Community Development Board and debated the timeline for the FY2021 municipal budget.

items.title: Council Statement on Race in Medford
items.summary: Councilors delivered an opening statement condemning the death of George Floyd and pledging to actively address systemic racial failures in Medford.

items.title: National Grid Grant of Location - Woodruff Avenue
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid to install an overhead line and pole near Woodruff Avenue for circuit reliability, subject to standard engineering conditions.

items.title: Special Permit - Sacramento Tattoo (475 High Street)
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Michael James Coleman to operate Sacramento Tattoo at 475 High Street, subject to a six-month review and specifying that the permit attaches to the business rather than the address.

items.title: FY2021 Budget Schedule and Publication Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city administration publish a schedule of in-person budget meetings and provide the FY2021 budget document as soon as possible.

items.title: Legal Opinion Request on Personnel and Diversity Department Consolidation
items.summary: Approved a request for the City Solicitor to evaluate whether consolidating the Office of Diversity and Office of Disability under the Personnel Director creates legal conflicts or liabilities.

items.title: Update on Police Department Use of Force Standards
items.summary: Referred a resolution seeking an update on Medford Police Department use-of-force standards and de-escalation policies to the Public Safety Subcommittee.

items.title: Summer Recreation and Youth Sports Planning
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting updates from the administration, Recreation Department, and Park Commission on summer recreation plans and youth sports guidelines.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions
items.summary: Approved resolutions wishing Peter Fuccioni a happy 75th birthday and congratulating the Medford High School Class of 2020 while commending organizers of the graduation parade.

items.title: Declaration of Systemic Racism as a Public Health Emergency
items.summary: Approved a resolution declaring systemic racism a public health emergency in Medford and inviting the Mayor and School Committee to issue a joint declaration.

items.title: Public Community Forums on Racism and Policing
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting the city urgently host public community forums with municipal officials, youth, and residents of color to discuss racism and policing.

items.title: State Municipal Governance Legislation Resolution
items.summary: Voted to receive and place on file a resolution requesting state legislative action after learning the underlying bill had already been signed into law.

items.title: School Committee FY2021 Budget Priorities Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the School Committee share its prioritized list of student outcome improvement items and draft budget documents.

items.title: Rescission of Unused Free Cash for Fire Department Radios
items.summary: Approved the mayor's recommendation to rescind $87,508 in unexpended free cash following completion of the Fire Department radio project under budget.

items.title: Adult Use Marijuana Zoning Ordinance
items.summary: Read and referred to the Community Development Board a comprehensive zoning ordinance regulating adult-use marijuana establishments.
